# OpenCode

Local Coder pins OpenCode **1.18.22** as the first general coding engine.

- Homepage: https://opencode.ai
- Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode
- License: MIT
- Install source used here: Homebrew formula `opencode` 1.18.22
- SHA-256 of `/opt/homebrew/bin/opencode` (and the app-owned copy):
  `33684a2aa6aad5386069fe44031f928aaa36cf860bb6e430ed7241ff92f6c8dd`

The binary is copied to `~/.local/share/local-coder/bin/opencode`. Local Coder
does not overwrite a user's personal OpenCode config or credentials.
